summary: Workhorse Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to existing credit agreements with lender Motive GM Holdings II LLC. The amendment increases a cash flow commitment from $20M to $30M, defers interest on the additional $10M until after September 30, 2026, reduces a customer order commitment from $30M to $20M, and requires Workhorse to issue warrants as consideration. This is a routine debt facility modification, not a special situation, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a current report of a material definitive agreement and a direct financial obligation.
